Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer loaded an incorrect/irrelevant Discogs page (showing “Crisis Energy” instead of Ben Weinman) and extracted misleading metadata stating “Born August 7, 1975.” It also surfaced a prompt-injected plan to mis-handle a UTC timestamp (converting a date of birth to local time and shifting the date), which is a logically incorrect approach for birthdays and conflicts with authoritative sources (Wikipedia). This introduced a plausible but wrong date that could directly propagate to a wrong final answer.
